verdict.rationale: Forter documents notification webhooks that push real-time notifications to a merchant server or ERP/OMS when events occur in Forter's system (forter-docs-3). It also documents a specific Forter-signed Request for Evidence webhook for dispute workflows (forter-docs-25). The Stripe and chargeback items describe inbound webhooks into Forter, not event subscriptions, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: a full event-type catalog and subscription-management details (API or self-serve), documented signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
